label.title: Label
label.description: Short label to help identify this credit transfer.

bic.title: BIC
bic.description: Bank Identifier Code used for international transfers.

number.title: Number
number.description: Account number, if IBAN not available.

clearing.title: Clearing Code
clearing.description:
National bank or branch clearing identifier, such as a Danish registration
number, UK sort code, or US routing number.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Bank office branch address, not normally required.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: Additional semi-structured data that may be useful.

pay.CreditTransfer.description: CreditTransfer contains fields that can be used for making payments via a bank transfer or wire.
